contact_profile_contract.method: dispatch contact_profile then cargo apply on static XML option probe; no physics

start_dock.source: authored static layout; no live robot positions or robot-to-row assignment

scene_contract.changed: all three spawn x coordinates: -0.85 -> -0.65 m; matching static keepouts/text
scene_contract.preserved: seeded row assignment, z/yaw, walls 0.10 m, tags_v2, cameras, cargo, commands and guards

pose_time.accepted_fix: raw accepted capture; strict after align start; report bounds tolerant in both directions; failed conjuncts logged

grasp_contract.command_time: raw SIM time in host _apply/_hold, identical to port/capture/relook clock; no command rounding; stop-wait failed conjuncts logged; memory look-fix capture time raw
grasp_contract.pose_contract: raw last_fix_t; fix_age_s; fix_source; std_xy_m/std_yaw_rad; observation_quality; provider-owned expected_observability and relocalization
grasp_contract.target_obstruction: active own pair job only; coarse order at initial pickup or fresh segment own RGB anchor; full band + colour/geometry/component support; merged/unknown/other objects retained; no collision guard changes

align_relook.reset: hold -> wait for fresh initialized post-stop own report and bounded stationary guard cache -> PF reset; wait counts in existing per-look and cumulative limits
align_relook.selection: safe LOOK_P20 pans ranked by provider expected_observability score; own pose and issued PWM only; actual new accepted own RGB observation required
align_relook.resume: same shared pose, fresh report, new accepted observation after stop, unchanged 5 cm/3 deg readiness and scheduling reserve; restore beam view; original align deadline retained
align_relook.status: aligning/abort only; existing close readiness barrier holds partner open
align_relook.basis: dev08 own report at 166.3: tag age 6 s, XY sigma .05486 m; 9.3 s before 175.6 HIGH .07004 m. Scheduling reserve is a dev bound, not calibrated safety/completion proof

grasp_contract.relook: mandatory at each grasp; shared own.pose/last_report; new observation fix in this sweep; no VO bypass
grasp_contract.attachment: own RGB grip-view after issued CLOSED, segment bound; cleared on issued OPEN; post-lift co-motion still required
grasp_contract.close: own open grip-view, pose readiness and fresh stationary RGB beam clearance -> close_ready_i -> same-grid close_go_i; recheck beam before every close PWM; evidence TTL 0.6 s
grasp_contract.stationary_beam: full own RGB standoff band centre + paired-edge axis; segment-local issued-command prediction including stall/slip uncertainty; clipped visible patch only checks consistency, never resets pose/age/sigma; no planned/stored-grip or wrist-attachment fallback; unchanged whole-beam distance and 35 mm + own pose + beam uncertainty inflation

beam_track.qualification: dev bounds, not measured motion success or calibrated accuracy

grasp_contract.qualification: not physically executed; no inherited result

timing.coverage_rule: round((sim_end_s - simulator_start_s) / applied timestep_s); initial observation is not a step
timing.wall_basis: previous wall_s * (new max_physics_steps / previous max_physics_steps); conservative step-count budget, not measured throughput or completion prediction; SIM horizon and GT/video rates unchanged; outer cleanup allowance unchanged

common_record: parent sim_cli workflow manifest links source/config/input/environment/result receipts
